name: snipd
description: Connect your agent to your Snipd account: read, delete and tag your podcast snips and notes, browse and manage the podcasts you follow, search moments in your subscriptions and listen history, find people by name or bio, open episodes (details, transcripts, AI snips), see your feeds and history, control your play queue, and upload your own audio.

interface.longDescription: Read the snips you saved in Snipd, with your notes, the AI summaries, the episode and show they come from, and your tags. Browse and manage the podcasts you follow, open any episode (details, transcript and AI snips where you have access), search for moments in your subscriptions and listen history, find people by name or bio, see your feeds and listen history, and control your play queue from your agent; your devices pick the changes up. You can also upload audio files and YouTube videos into their Snipd library. Signs in with your Snipd account. Changes to your account (deleting or tagging snips, subscribing, the play queue, uploads) are only made after you confirm them.
capabilities: Search moments in your subscriptions and listen history
Find people by name or bio
Open episodes: details, transcripts and AI snips
See your feeds and listen history
Upload audio files and YouTube videos
defaultPrompt: Show my most recent Snipd snips grouped by episode
What is new in the podcasts I follow on Snipd?
Queue the latest episode of my favourite podcast next

positive.description: List the user's saved snips with their notes, episode and show
positive.prompt: Show my most recent Snipd snips grouped by episode, with my notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's newest snips grouped by episode, each with the episode and show title, the snip's note or summary, its position in the episode and its tags.

positive.description: Tag snips, asking before changing the account
positive.prompt: Tag my three most recent Snipd snips with "to review".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the three newest snips, confirms the change with the user, then files them under the tag "to review" (created if missing). The tag shows on those snips in the Snipd app.

positive.description: See new episodes from followed podcasts and queue one
positive.prompt: What's new in the podcasts I follow on Snipd? Queue the newest episode to play next.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent unplayed episodes from the followed podcasts, newest first, then adds the newest one at the front of the play queue and confirms it. The queue in the Snipd app shows it next.

positive.description: Search moments across followed podcasts (Snipd Premium)
positive.prompt: Find moments in the podcasts I follow on Snipd where they talk about sleep.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns transcript passages about sleep from episodes of followed podcasts, each with the episode, show, timestamp and a link to the moment.

positive.description: Recap the last listened episode with its AI snips
positive.prompt: What was the last podcast episode I listened to on Snipd, and what were its key points?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the most recently played episode and show with the listening progress, then summarizes the episode's AI snips as its key points.

negative.description: Podcast hosting and publishing is not something Snipd does
negative.prompt: Publish my new podcast episode to Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

negative.description: Music libraries in other apps are out of scope
negative.prompt: Add the album I'm listening to on Spotify to my library.

negative.description: Highlights in books or documents are not podcast snips
negative.prompt: Highlight the second paragraph of this PDF and save it to my Kindle notes.
